items.name: Savoury Chicken Burger Set(Halal)with Crispy Fries
items.description: Juicy perfectly battered seasoned chicken patty, topped with fresh lettuce, ripe tomato with a special sauce all nestled between soft buns. Accompanied by golden, crispy fries.

items.name: Spicy Chicken Ramyeon 韩式辣鸡肉拉面
items.description:
Dive into a comforting bowl of fiery Korean ramyeon, topped with crispy fried chicken and a perfectly runny egg for ultimate slurp-worthy satisfaction!
一碗火辣暖心的韩式拉面，搭配酥脆炸鸡与完美流心蛋，让您尽享大呼过瘾的极致美味！

items.name: Kimchi Ramyeon 韩国泡菜拉面
items.description:
Savor a comforting bowl of spicy and tangy Kimchi Ramyeon, loaded with juicy sausages, tender fish cakes, and authentic kimchi for a classic Korean delight!
品尝一碗酸辣暖胃的韩国泡菜拉面，搭配多汁香肠、鲜嫩鱼饼和地道泡菜，尽享经典韩式美味！

items.name: Cheesy Chicken Corn Dog (2 stick) 芝士鸡肉玉米热狗
items.description:
Two golden, crispy chicken corn dogs generously drizzled with rich cheese sauce and creamy mayo. The ultimate savory comfort snack, delivering a satisfying crunch on the outside and irresistible flavor in every bite!
淋满浓郁芝士与柔滑美乃滋的金黄酥脆鸡肉玉米热狗，为您带来外层酥脆、每一口都令人无法抗拒的极致美味！
